checks.purpose: Bind one exact product candidate and acceptance-bound byte set.
Require current complete product-test evidence for the frozen candidate.
Determine product-approval request eligibility without granting approval.
Keep product approval separate from later authority, admission, activation, and release decisions.

claim_ceiling: This candidate profile evaluates a frozen product candidate. PASS does not approve the product or authorize admission, activation, release, or deployment.
decision_rule: PASS establishes eligibility for a separate product decision only; it grants no approval or post-approval authority.
